hooks.text: Up to twenty-five hundred people died in the Peshtigo Fire.
How did a Wisconsin wildfire kill more than a thousand people?
Chicago burned the same night as America’s deadliest wildfire.

title: Peshtigo: The Fire Chicago Overshadowed
description: On October 8–9, 1871, southwest winds drove a firestorm through Peshtigo, Wisconsin, killing an estimated 1,200–2,500 people. The Great Chicago Fire burned the same night and drew much of the nation’s attention.
